Object paced airliner near Coral Ridge, pilot says

Meridian Wire staff — 15 March 2026

An object paced a commercial aircraft for about four minutes near Coral Ridge on 2 March, according to the pilot involved.

"It held station off the right wing, then left on a vector we could not match," Captain R. Alvarado said.

Meridian Wire has not independently confirmed the account. The quotation and the timeline are as first reported by Harbour Dispatch.
